references.text: Direct parallel text confirming Eliphaz's sons and chiefs in both genealogies.
Complementary text within the same chapter that expands the list of Esau's tribal chiefs beyond Eliphaz's line.
Concluding verse in the same list confirming that all mentioned chiefs belong to Esau/Edom.
Direct genealogical link placing Eliphaz (the main figure in the source verse) as a son of Esau.
